dead_code.expected_solution: At kubernetes@v1.28.0, the flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1beta2 API group is deprecated and slated for removal — staging/src/k8s.io/api/flowcontrol/v1beta2/types.go declares the types, and pkg/registry/flowcontrol/rest/storage_flowcontrol.go shows how registration is being shifted toward v1beta3 / v1 successors. client-go@v0.28.0 still ships generated typed clients, informers, listers, and fake clients for v1beta2 — kubernetes/typed/flowcontrol/v1beta2/flowcontrol_client.go is the typed-client anchor and informers/flowcontrol/v1beta2/interface.go is the informer anchor. An ideal answer enumerates each generated artifact under client-go for the deprecated group, classifies it as 'partially dead' (because the group still exists under newer versions), and notes that v1beta2 will be served by aggregation-style compatibility until removal. Any reply must contain a non-empty array of objects with `file` and `symbol` fields so the dead_code verifier can compute precision/recall — the headline pair to flag is (kubernetes/typed/flowcontrol/v1beta2/flowcontrol_client.go, FlowcontrolV1beta2Client).
evaluation_criteria: Answer must be a non-empty JSON array (not an object) where every entry carries `file` and `symbol` fields — the verifier extracts (file, symbol) tuples for precision/recall scoring

Must reference at least the typed client at kubernetes/typed/flowcontrol/v1beta2/flowcontrol_client.go and the informer at informers/flowcontrol/v1beta2/interface.go (the GT required-file anchors in client-go)

Must classify each entry's status as 'removed' or 'deprecated' and identify the API server registration source in staging/src/k8s.io/api/flowcontrol/v1beta2/types.go that proves the API surface is going away

The verifier rewards quality keywords like 'deprecated', 'removed', 'no callers', 'unreachable', and 'no longer'; vague labels like 'old' score lower. At minimum 60% of entries should hit a quality keyword.
evaluation_criteria: Every entry must populate a non-empty `evidence` field (the verifier scores 0.6× evidence_ratio + 0.4× quality_ratio)
Evidence text should hit quality keywords such as 'deprecated', 'removed', 'no callers', 'unreachable', or 'no longer' — used by the verifier's keyword-quality bonus
